name: Santa Fe
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Santa Fe provincial sources identify the Servicio de Catastro e Información Territorial (SCIT) as the provincial cadastral/cartographic custodian and IDESF as the public spatial-data infrastructure. The municipal Santa Fe GeoPortal separately advertises official cadastral layers and technical resources.
technicalBlocker: The official IDESF WMS exposes parcel display layers but marks both scit_parcelas and scit_parcelas_identificador queryable=0. A bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo request at the exact WUP point returned LayerNotQueryable, so no safe ID-plus-geometry response was available. The provincial parcel-search page is a lookup form requiring a parcel identifier or coordinate interaction, but no usable parcel response was obtained within the bounded request attempt.
